verdict.rationale: Netlify documents its own AI Gateway, which lets project code connect to popular AI models without managing API keys. That implies inference access without operating GPUs, but the evidence never describes global or edge execution, a single-call API, or capacity handling. The gateway reads as a connector to hosted models rather than Netlify-run global inference. missing for 10: evidence of globally distributed inference execution, a documented single-call inference API, explicit statements on GPU and capacity abstraction, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an ai-native builder, I can run AI model inference globally with a single call without managing GPUs or capacity planning
